name: ground-band-split-colour
description: From the title screen, enter the first world and let it settle, then poke a sentinel into $7C8A, the colour the MFP Timer B handler at $052280 writes into hardware colour 8 ($FF8250) part-way down the frame, and break on the next write. Names the latch that turns the lower half of the one-colour viewport fill into the ground band below the horizon (#281).
